subject: can't make validation confusion matrix after randomForest is build

messages.author: f09342664ef43bfc
messages.subject: can't make validation confusion matrix after randomForest is build
parts:
Hi Graham,

I got this problem last week. I have 1500 rows with 1300 column. I tried to build a random forest model and I succeed. But after that I tried evaluate it's performance using validation dataset. I got a error like this:

E142: A command has failed

overall <- function(x)
{
  if (nrow(x) == 2) 
    cat((x[1,2] + x[2,1]) / sum(x)) 
  else
    cat(1 - (x[1,rownames(x)]) / sum(x))
} 
overall(table(crs$pr, na.omit(crs$dataset[crs$validate, c(crs$input, crs$target)])$fraud,  
        dnn=c("Predicted", "Actual")))

 The action you requested has not been completed. Refer to the R Console for details. 

Rattle 2.6.26 77

can you give me some suggestions? I tried to reinstalled rattle but it did not solve the problem/

Thanks.

Jay

messages.author: a5fc253a7399c40c
messages.subject: Re: can't make validation confusion matrix after randomForest is build
parts:
Jay,

I'm not an expert on the inner workings of rattle, but I did have a similar issue a couple of years ago...

Do you have missing data? Sometimes by dumb luck the training set won't have a variable or a level that appears in the validation set, and then weirdness occurs.

That's all I can think of... Maybe someone else has other suggestions.

Scott
